item.title: Gudeng posts record seven-month revenue on EUV Pod orders and global demand
item.summary: Gudeng Precision Industrial reported record revenue for the first seven months of 2026, supported by stronger EUV pod orders and rising purchases from overseas customers for advanced semiconductor shipping containers. The company said demand tied to advanced-process ramp-ups, 2nm volume production, and advanced packaging will keep full-year 2026 growth on track, with second-half performance expected to outpace the first half.
